readme:
# Campus Connect

A unified club event, registration, and ticketing platform for university campus student organizations.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React 18 with TypeScript & Tailwind CSS
- Backend: FastAPI (Python 3.11+)
- Database: Supabase PostgreSQL (Production), SQLite (Local Dev)
- Deployment: Hosted on Render Web Services

## Local Setup
```bash
git clone https://github.com/campus-club/campus-connect.git
cd campus-connect
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --reload
```
